# Model specification: barometer 1.0.0

Command-based pressure sensor with calibration PROM (MS5611 on SPI or I2C). Values come from the common sensor source.

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | PROM, conversions, ADC read. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| reset | control | base | Reset command; reloads the PROM. |
| prom | data | base | Calibration words C1..C6 and the CRC word (PROM read commands). |
| convert_pressure | control | base | Starts a D1 conversion at an oversampling ratio. |
| convert_temperature | control | base | Starts a D2 conversion at an oversampling ratio. |
| adc_read | data | base | 24-bit result of the last completed conversion (0 if none). |
| conversion_time | status | base | Datasheet conversion time per oversampling ratio. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-BARO-B001 | base | After reset the PROM holds fixed calibration words whose CRC-4 (AN520) is valid (ADV-CHIP-MS5611-001). |
| ADV-BARO-B002 | base | A pressure p and temperature T from the sensor source read, through D1 and D2, as raw values that the datasheet's first-order compensation with the PROM coefficients turns back into p and T within one count (the model inverts the compensation). |
| ADV-BARO-B003 | base | adc_read returns the result of the last conversion only after its conversion_time has passed; read earlier (or without a conversion) it returns 0, as the datasheet states. |
| ADV-BARO-B004 | base | The same commands work on SPI and on I2C (bus binding from the Devicetree). |

**Timing.** Conversions complete conversion_time after the command in model time.

**Out of scope.** second-order temperature compensation effects, noise (from the source values)
